Build matrix script for gcc and clang targets with dependency setup and failure reporting

# Purpose
This Bash script runs a build matrix for a project across multiple compiler versions, machine configuration files, and Makefile targets. It can use GCC or Clang installations under `/opt`, install or skip dependencies, install Rust, and run either full builds or `make check`. The script also supports exclusion lists for specific compiler, machine, and target combinations, and it records build output in a temporary log file so it can report failed targets and print logs when requested. It is a build automation entry point rather than a library file, and it is intended to drive repeated compile and test runs in a controlled environment.
